summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 12, 1892, page 7

facts.fact: Allen, billed as retired champion pugilist of the world, kept a place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening
